skill.summary: 中文网页搜索 - 聚合 17 个免费搜索引擎，无需 API Key，纯网页抓取，支持公众号/财经/技术/学术/知识搜索。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cn-web-search skill.

- Aggregates 13+ free Chinese search engines
- No API key required; completely free to use
- Supports searching on public WeChat accounts, Zhihu, finance (A-shares), and technical sources
- All results fetched via web scraping (no API dependencies)
